title: WebMCP tools: expose page actions to browser AI agents
why: A component can register typed actions (add a task, search) with the browser's model context, so AI agents act through declared tools instead of guessing clicks.

adopt.snippet:
<meta tools="add_task: Add a task (text:str!, due:date)">
<script>
  const tasks = sig([])
  function add_task({ text, due }) { tasks.push({ text, due }) }
</script>
